name: Unitree Dex3-1
summary: Three-finger force-controlled dexterous hand, 7 DoF, with 33 tactile sensors.
body: Unitree lists 7 degrees of freedom (thumb 3, index 2, middle 2), 710 g, a 500 g load on a 5 cm round object and 33 pressure sensors in 9 areas, and says it can be used with the G1 ([unitree.com/Dex3-1](https://www.unitree.com/Dex3-1)). No price is listed.
